- Wed Apr 15 at 15:00 AKDT (75m) — alternate

- Confirm whether you require HSM-backed KMS or a customer-managed key store (we saw both options in the pre-read).
- Anything in the diagram labelled as "management plane" that must be air-gapped from operators — call that out.
- A point-of-contact for on-site networking during the call (name + cell).

I'll attach our private-deploy checklist as a working doc; we typically walk through it in the first 20 minutes, then dig into a targeted topic set (networking, update mechanics, logging/audit).

If the Tue slot works we'll send a calendar invite. If you need to shift, flag alternate times and we'll adjust.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Quick pre-call checklist / agenda so we hit the right level:
1) 15m — Introductions & high-level constraints (AnchorEdge POCs, timelines)
2) 20m — Network boundary walk (bastion/management plane, allowed egress patterns)
3) 20m — Key management & signing (KMS vs HSM, rotation cadence, audit hooks)
4) 15m — Update/patch workflow for air-gapped nodes + rollback playbook
5) 5m — Next steps & action items (owner assignment)

Pre-call ask (one pager or annotated diagram if possible): specify any third-party appliances (proxy, hardware HSM, swap space) and confirm whether you require signed images and an offline image distribution workflow. If you can drop the updated diagrams in the Drive link below, Vivek and Grace will review before the meeting.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1aB2cDEfGhijK/view?usp=sharing
